SWD.texto:
Most skull wall decor is a flat image behind glass. This is not that.

The MAVRA Skull Wall Decor Set is three sculpted polyresin skulls with real depth — anatomical brow ridges, hollow orbits, and a dense weight you feel the moment you lift one. The matte black finish absorbs light instead of bouncing it, so the shadows stay where they belong and the piece reads as an object, not a picture of one.

Three sizes, staggered on purpose: 8.15in, 7.3in and 6.7in. Hang them tight for one dark cluster or spread them across the wall and let the space breathe. There is no single right arrangement — that is the point.

Mount it your way. Screws and wall anchors are included for permanent placement; the double-sided adhesive strips hold on smooth walls when drilling is not an option, which makes this a straight answer for renters and dorm rooms.

Built for a bedroom, an office, a reading corner, an entryway or a home bar — anywhere the gothic aesthetic is a way of living rather than a season. It does not come down in November.

Works as a gothic gift for someone whose taste already runs dark, and pairs with the rest of the MAVRA collection when you are ready to build the whole room.

Sculpted, not stamped. Mount once, haunt forever.

CND.texto:
A candle you light is gone. A candle you keep is decor.

The MAVRA Skull Candle Set is sculpted from real black paraffin — a true black all the way through, not a white candle dipped in color. The skull stands 4.53in with anatomical detail carved into the bone structure; the spine runs 5.67in, segment by segment, and reads as a sculpture long before you ever bring a flame near it.

Two scented tealights complete the set: pine and moss. Forest after rain, cold earth, dark wood. No vanilla, no dessert notes, no bakery — a scent that belongs in the room this candle is built for.

Burn times are honest: roughly 12 hours for the skull, 6 for the spine. Which means you can use them for a ritual, a dinner, a long night of reading — or never light them at all and let them hold a shelf, an altar or a mantel indefinitely. Both readings are correct.

The matte black finish makes it sit right next to gothic and witchy home decor, dark academia shelves, apothecary jars and skull decor you already own. It is permanent decor, not a seasonal prop — this stays out in March.

Arrives ready to give: a complete set, boxed, for the person whose aesthetic runs black year-round.

Hold the dark. The ritual begins when you decide it does.

LMP.texto:
This lamp does two things at once: it lights the room, and it casts the room in shadow.

The MAVRA Skull Lamp is a sculpted skull inside a black metal cage shade, and the cage is the whole trick — light escapes through the bars and throws a shadow pattern across your wall and ceiling. Turn it on in a dark room and the lamp stops being furniture and becomes atmosphere.

Three shade modes, because one look is never enough: the matte veil for a soft, heavy dark; the glitter veil for a scattered, star-like throw; and the naked cage for the hardest, sharpest shadow projection of the three. Swap them in seconds.

A 3-level touch dimmer runs it — no switch to hunt for, no app, no pairing. Tap once for low, again for medium, again for full. It takes a standard E26 bulb, so when the bulb finally goes you replace it at any hardware store instead of ordering a proprietary part. The bulb is included to start.

At 5.4 x 12.2in it fits a nightstand, a desk, a bookshelf or a side table without taking the surface hostage. Bedside reading light by function, gothic table lamp by design.

It belongs in a goth bedroom, a dark academia study, a witchy corner or an office that refuses to look like every other office. Permanent decor — this is not a seasonal piece and it does not get packed away.

Cast the dark. Then change how it falls.
